policyIntro.title: About This Policy
policyIntro.text:
We respect your privacy at [Website Name] and value your information. Here, we want to describe how we collect, use, and ensure data protection while you browse our website or use our services. Each time you visit our site, you agree to abide by the practices described in this policy, which are built on trust and openness in dealing with information.

Just by visiting and accessing this website, you have agreed to allow the collection and use of certain information according to this policy

infoCollection.title: Information We Collect
infoCollection.intro: We collect both non-personally identifying and personally-identifying information.

nonPersonal.title: 1. Non-Personally Identifying Information
nonPersonal.text:
We also gather a portion of non-personally identifiable information transmitted with your request once you visit our website.
            This comprises information such as your browser type, language preference, the webpage that led you to visit us, and the time of your
            visit. We consider this information to understand visitor's behavior on our site and improve the overall user experience on our website.
            To analyze trends, monitor performance, and identify areas for improvement, we may aggregate this information also.

personal.title: 2. Personal Identifying Information
personal.intro: On each occasion you visit our website, we may ask for your details, which may include:
personal.text:
We do it when necessary only to serve the purpose, such as subscribing to our newsletter or seeking help by lodging a support request.
            We collect your email simply to keep in touch with you.

infoUse.title: How We Use Your Information
infoUse.intro: We may use your information in the following ways:

list.text: Improving Our Offerings: We study user behavior to enhance the website and our services.
For communication: to carry on updates, newsletters, or important notices regarding your account or services.
To Assist Customers: We may use your email or phone number to address any concerns or requests you may have.

infoSharing.title: Sharing Your Information
infoSharing.intro: We value your privacy and don’t give out your data to outside parties. We might, however, disclose your information for the following purposes:

list.text: Service Providers: We transfer personal information to companies or other parties that help us in our operations and business, such as providing payment processing or hosting services.
Legal Compliance: We can tell your personal information if the law requires or authorizes such action or if we want to protect our rights.

infoSecurity.title: How We Keep Your Information Secure

list.text: Encryption: To protect private data during transmission, we have encryption.
Secure Servers: Our company stores your information on secure servers and utilizes current security protocols.
Access Control: Your personal data is only accessible by authorized staff members.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience while you visit our site. Cookies are small files placed on your device that help us:
list: Identify you when you return to our site.
Track your preferences and interactions with our website.
Record website traffic and improve your user experience.
cookies.text: If you don’t want cookies to be installed on your device, you can do this through your browser settings. Note that injuring or refusing cookies may impact the way specific functionality of this website works.

firmTransfers.title: Firm Transfers
firmTransfers.text: We might give information to one or more third parties as part of a transaction if we sell or buy out our company.  Any acquirer or successor may continue to use your information following this Privacy Policy.

ads.title: Ads
ads.text: Our website includes advertisements from third-party advertisers. Such advertisers may use their cookies to collect data regarding our activities while visiting our site to provide you with targeted advertisements based on your interests. This Privacy Notice excludes third-party advertisers and exclusively addresses how we manage cookies.

comments.title: Comments
comments.text: We gather your IP address, email address, and other submitted content if you post a comment on our website or through other contact channels on the site. To help identify spam comments, the gathered data can be sent to the anti-spam service. If your comment is marked as a false positive, we may store it for a short time to better function.

userRights.title: Your Rights and Choices
userRights.intro: You have the following rights as a user about your data:

list.text: You are allowed to see the personal information we have on file about you.
Where you believe that your data is not correct, you inform us. We are bound to correct it accordingly.
You have the right to delete your data. Note that the deletion of your data might limit access to some features that we offer on our website.

list: You can unsubscribe from newsletters or marketing emails at any time by following the instructions in those emails.

policyChanges.title: Changes to Our Privacy Policy
policyChanges.text: We shall at all times have the right to update or modify the Privacy Policy. All major changes made to the Privacy Policy shall be provided to you either through e-mail or otherwise by publishing new terms on this page. You agree to the change to these terms by restarting to access our website after we make updates to the Privacy Policy.
policyChanges.contactText: If you have any questions or concerns, don’t hesitate to contact us. We’re always happy to help!
